# stayfresh

> Static archive of workflow research and patterns for AI-assisted development.

## Posts

- [sleepcast: bedtime audio with an inverted rubric](https://stayfresh.dev/research/sleepcast/): a bedtime audio product whose generation rubric inverts every content incentive: repetition is good, drift is good, resolution is bad, and a completed play is a failure signal.
- [techno-alexithymia: de-skilling introspection](https://stayfresh.dev/research/techno-alexithymia/): delegating emotional self-naming to a language model is the same de-skilling mechanism as offloading judgment to a coding agent, applied to the most interior faculty there is.
- [agents.md effectiveness](https://stayfresh.dev/research/agents-md-effectiveness/): evaluating repository-level context files for coding agents.
- [enterprise agent design](https://stayfresh.dev/research/enterprise-agent-design/): bcg framework for production-grade agents.
- [formal verification with agents](https://stayfresh.dev/research/formal-verification-agents/): property-based testing and specification generation.
- [persona anchors](https://stayfresh.dev/research/persona-anchors/): character-based instruction patterns for consistent agent behavior.
- [reward engineering for coding agents](https://stayfresh.dev/research/reward-engineering/): why coding agents optimize the rubric more than the prompt.
- [reward hacking in coding agents](https://stayfresh.dev/research/reward-hacking/): how poorly designed metrics produce plausible but unstable code.
- [agent psychology](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/agent-psychology/): understanding how agents reason and respond to instructions.
- [ci automation with ai agents](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/ci-automation/): integrating ai agents with continuous integration workflows.
- [instant project sync](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/instant-project-sync/): synchronize ticket queues against contract dates and repository evidence, with requirement reconstruction when docs are missing.
- [preference toml](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/preference-toml/): use rlhf-shaped semantics in a simple config dsl for agent evaluation loops.
- [project ai philosophy](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/project-ai-philosophy/): a written position for bounded, evidence-backed ai use in delivery.
- [prompt patterns](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/prompt-patterns/): common prompt structures for reliable agent behavior.
- [psay agent notifications](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/psay-agent-notify/): local voice and notification center loops for agent completion, handoff, and operator recall.
- [reward rubric dsl](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/reward-rubric-dsl/): a small machine-readable format for scoring coding agent output.
- [context is a budget](https://stayfresh.dev/research/context-is-a-budget/): more tokens do not create more truth; useful context is what changes the next decision.
- [protocol before personality](https://stayfresh.dev/research/protocol-before-personality/): shared artifacts and exit conditions beat charisma, cosplay, and fake seniority.
- [specs as shared reality](https://stayfresh.dev/research/specs-as-shared-reality/): agents do not share understanding. they share binding artifacts, versions, and tests.
- [what is prompting: operational constraints](https://stayfresh.dev/research/what-is-prompting/): prompting is a constrained pipeline where tokenization, max tokens, and control tokens form the operational boundaries that determine agent behavior.
- [claude code skills stack](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/claude-code-skills-stack/): a practical three-layer stack for claude code: decision, context, and execution.
- [modular workflow stack](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/modular-workflow-stack/): right tool, right job, right time: layered orchestration, typed agent delegation, human-in-the-loop gates, parallelism, and loops with real halting conditions.
- [anubis in front of github pages](https://stayfresh.dev/workflows/anubis-github-pages/): how to put anubis in front of a github pages site with a real reverse proxy and no proxy-loop nonsense.

- [Atom Feed](https://stayfresh.dev/atom.xml): Recent site updates in Atom 1.0 format.
- [JSON Feed](https://stayfresh.dev/feed.json): Machine-readable feed for applications that prefer JSON.
